g.title: J8
g.text: Zero 2 W. Pin 1 is nearest the microSD slot, inner row (square pad on the underside). Pin 1 also feeds U5 and U6; see wiring-io.

g.title: U1
g.text: Adafruit 3006. VIN-SD: left channel. VIN-GAIN: 6 dB. Supply from U5 with C1 and C2 at VIN; see wiring-power. SPK- is not GND.

g.title: SP1
g.text: Adafruit 3351 enclosed 3 W 4 Ω on foam or rubber decoupling. Amplifier + to speaker +. JST-PH 2.0 cable into 3006 screw terminals. Keep under 10 cm.

g.title: U2
g.text: 3.3 V only. Bottom port seals to its own faceplate opening through a gasket and membrane. SEL jumpered to GND (left).

g.title: J_CSI
g.text: Standard-Mini 200 mm ribbon. Contacts face the PCB.

g.title: CAM1
g.text: IMX708 with infrared-cut filter. 15-pin camera end of the Standard-Mini cable.
